sourceFile: 07. TIU C11-20 Result test AWF JIG Cut guide more  2025.12.10_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft cites valid rows but misidentifies the primary changed factor and outcome metric grouping.
issues: Primary factor should be cut-more-guide JIG TEST vs Normal, not date comparison.
Baseline/test conditions are reversed or unclear in changedFactors.
Outcome metric should be Total NG rate and NG categories, not section title.
Date/shift differences are subgroup or confounding context and must be preserved.
Comparison uses one Normal row against multiple JIG TEST date/shift rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the single 12/10 DAY Normal row an acceptable control for all JIG TEST rows?
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to AWF jig cut-more-guide/JIG TEST condition.
Set baselineCondition to Normal and changedCondition to JIG TEST cut-more-guide.
Keep date and day/night as subgroup keys, not primary factors.
Rename outcome to Total NG rate with NG coil damage/separate counts.
State limitation that control coverage is only 12/10 DAY Normal.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and are sufficient, but interpretation needs correction.
